author: Reuters
description:
Iran's soccer team arrived in the United States for the first time at this World Cup on June 14, landing at Los Angeles ‌International Airport just before a peace deal between the nations was announced.

The squad arrived after a short flight from Tijuana, Mexico, where they left their base camp earlier to a rousing sendoff ahead of their opening game against New Zealand at Los Angeles Stadium on Monday. Jane Ross reports from outside their hotel. 

#Iran #UnitedStates #WorldCup #PeaceDeal #LA
title: Iran team arrives in US for World Cup opener
